faq.title: Frequently Asked

1.ask: Where can I buy HaYo products?
1.quest: Currently, HaYo products can only be purchased directly at official HaYo outlets.

2.ask: Can I purchase HaYo products through the app?
2.quest: Not yet. The HaYo app cannot currently be used to make purchases or pay for products.

3.ask: Is HaYo available on GoFood, GrabFood, or ShopeeFood?
3.quest: Currently, HaYo does not serve purchases through third-party platforms such as GoFood, GrabFood, ShopeeFood, or similar platforms.

4.ask: What is the HaYo website and app used for?
4.quest: The HaYo website provides brand information, product and topping catalogs, and outlet locations. The HaYo app provides access to HaYo memberships and provides information on brands, products, toppings, and outlet locations. The information displayed is for informational purposes only and is subject to change at any time, in accordance with HaYo's policies.

5.ask: How to become a HaYo member?
5.quest: Customers can become HaYo members through the HaYo application according to the applicable registration mechanism.

6.ask: How does the HaYo e-stamp system work?
6.quest:
E-stamp is a digital stamp available in the HaYo application. 
• Every purchase of Small and Medium sizes will get 1 e-stamp. 
• Every purchase of Large size will get 2 e-stamps. 
• Collected e-stamps can be exchanged for free products according to the applicable conditions. 
• After collecting 50 e-stamps, users will level up and 2 e-stamps will be immediately unlocked according to the applicable mechanism. 
• E-stamp and membership conditions are subject to change at any time according to HaYo's policy.

7.ask: Does HaYo have vouchers or gift cards?
7.quest: HaYo can provide vouchers or gift cards according to applicable programs. Use of vouchers or gift cards is subject to the terms, conditions, validity period, and redemption mechanism listed on each voucher or gift card.

8.ask: Are the products displayed on the website or app always the same as those available in stores?
8.quest: Product selection, flavors, toppings, sizes, and availability may vary depending on the store and time of day. The product and topping information displayed on the website or app is for informational purposes only and is subject to change.

9.ask: Can paid orders be cancelled, exchanged or returned?
9.quest: Orders that have been processed and/or paid for cannot be cancelled, changed, exchanged or returned, unless there is an error in the order from HaYo or the product is received in a condition unfit for consumption.

10.ask: What if I want to submit a complaint?
10.quest: Complaints can be submitted on the same day, provided they show valid proof of purchase. HaYo reserves the right to verify the complaint before determining a resolution.

11.ask: Are HaYo products safe for customers with certain allergies?
11.quest: HaYo products may contain or come into contact with certain ingredients such as milk, nuts, gluten, or other allergens. If you have a history of allergies or dietary restrictions, we recommend that you consult with our staff before purchasing.

12.quest: PT Halal Artisan Yummies is committed to consistently using halal and high-quality ingredients in every production process and producing products with guaranteed halal certification. We are currently in the process of obtaining halal certification.

faq.title_bottom: Still have unanswered questions? Don't hesitate to Contact Us.
